clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: Vendor shall provide patient analytics services, including the processing of protected health information.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: Customer assumes unlimited liability for all claims arising from Vendor's services. Vendor's liability is capped at one US dollar ($1.00).

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Vendor may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause and without notice. Customer may terminate only with three hundred sixty-five (365) days written notice.

clauses.title: Data Handling
clauses.text: Vendor will process Customer data in accordance with industry best practices. No specific compliance framework is warranted.

risk_findings.risk: Unlimited liability assumed by Customer; vendor liability capped at $1
Asymmetric termination rights; customer locked in for 365 days
